title: WRSR Tweaks — Complete Collection
description: Complete collection of native x64 C++20 quality-of-life & logistics mods for Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic (RML & TesmioLoader).

items.workshopTitle: WRSR Tweaks: Adaptive Sim Speed (Smooth Fast-Forward)
items.summary: Native x64 C++20 plugin for **Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic** (`SOVIET64.exe`) that turns Fast Forward (`>>`) into a hardware-adaptive fast-forward (up to `15.0x`) via the shared **`F9`** multi-mod overlay (`WRSR Tweaks [F9]`), scaling simulation speed dynamically to your available CPU/GPU headroom without tanking FPS in late-game cities.

items.workshopTitle: WRSR Tweaks: Construction Office Vehicle Sizing
items.summary: Native x64 plugin for **Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic** (`SOVIET64.exe`) that optimizes Construction Office (CO) vehicle dispatch so COs match truck and bus sizes to actual construction demand instead of sending oversized vehicles for tiny remaining workloads.

Native x64 C++20 plugin for **Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic** (`SOVIET64.exe`) that scales **Customs House (`$TYPE_CUSTOMHOUSE`)** cargo **Load** and **Unload** speeds at runtime (`0.25x` – `100.0x`) via the shared **`F9`** multi-mod overlay (`WRSR Tweaks [F9]`), while leaving domestic stations, warehouses, and factories untouched.

Non-destructive Virtual File System (VFS) path redirector for **Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic** (`SOVIET64.exe`) that transparently redirects read-only file opens and attribute checks targeting `media_soviet\...` to override packs on disk—allowing players to stack local and Steam Workshop base-file replacement mods with priority ordering and conflict detection via the **`F9`** overlay, without ever overwriting original game files in `media_soviet\`.

items.workshopTitle: WRSR Tweaks: Multi-Bay Station Entry (No Queues)
items.summary: Native x64 C++ plugin for **Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic** (`SOVIET64.exe`) that eliminates single-vehicle courtyard bottlenecks at multi-bay road buildings (cargo stations, depots, Customs Houses, bus platforms) via the unified `F9` overlay.

items.workshopTitle: WRSR Tweaks: Distribution Office Fill Limits
items.summary: A DLL plugin for *Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic* that prevents Distribution Offices from dispatching vehicles unless a configurable minimum fill threshold is met. Configured via the shared **F9** overlay tab "DO Batching".

items.workshopTitle: WRSR Tweaks: Tech Services Dispatch Thresholds
items.summary: Native x64 C++ plugin for **Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic** (`SOVIET64.exe`) that lets you customize Technical Services dispatch thresholds at runtime via the unified `F9` overlay.

items.workshopTitle: WRSR Tweaks: Customs Price Limits (Buy & Sell)
items.summary: Native x64 C++20 plugin for **Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic** (`SOVIET64.exe`) that stops Distribution Offices (`Road` and `Rail`) from dispatching new imports above your **Max Buy** cap or new exports below your **Min Sell** floor at Customs Houses.
